goal.title: Make a cool website
goal.pitch: Build a complete personal portfolio website from a single description.

checks.name: site
checks.command: npm run build && npm run check:site

checks.name: ui-build
checks.command: npm --prefix swarm-ui ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix swarm-ui run build

targets.name: Generator
targets.description: scripts/build.mjs: turns the single description.md into the static site in dist/. Owns what a description can express and how forgiving the parser is.

targets.name: Portfolio site
targets.description: The page a visitor sees: layout, typography, theming, responsiveness and accessibility of the generated site. Basic site first.

targets.name: Guest server
targets.description: A small local Node server (node:sqlite, no dependencies) that serves dist/ and adds the guest counter, then guest messages, with end-to-end tests. Local only.

project.name: My Test Website Proj
project.tagline: A swarm-built portfolio: one description in, a site with a guest counter and guestbook out.
